title: DayZero Warm-hand-off: Rapid Hiring Slate + Interview Grid
body:
Purpose:
A compact, practical working doc to 1) speed final hiring decisions for small candidate slates, 2) standardize the interview scoring grid for cross-functional senior ICs, and 3) produce a DayZero warm-hand-off packet for the onboarding owner. Meant for quick use by hiring manager + recruiter + panel captain.

When to use this:
- Urgent backfill or high-priority hire where median time-to-offer target is <= 7 days.
- Internal transfers where hiring manager needs a concise warm-hand-off artifact for Day0.

Top-level flow (one page, actionable):
1) Recruiter creates the DayZero slate in Confluence and assigns Panel Captain (PC).
2) PC runs a 30-min pre-panel on candidate signals + red flags; updates the slate.
3) Interview panels run (no more than 3 loops total).
4) Scorecards due within 24 hours; consolidated by PC.
5) Decision meeting (15–30m) same day as last panel.
6) If offer, recruiter assembles DayZero packet and schedules welcome sync.

Hiring timeline template (compact):
- Day -4: Slack surface (role + priority), resume shortlist + quick screen scheduled.
- Day -3: Hiring manager + recruiter calibrate rubric and core evaluation questions.
- Day 0: Paneling (3 × 45-min loops or 2 × 60-min loops).
- Day 1: Scorecards consolidated; decision meeting by afternoon.
- Day 2: Offer approval + comp calibration.
- Day 3: Offer sent.

Interview grid (single unified rubric) — use numbers 1-5, write one-line evidence for each:
- Domain competence (system design / model serving / infra knowledge) — weight 35%
  - 5 = robust end-to-end system diagrams, tradeoffs, capacity planning examples
  - 3 = understands concepts, minor gaps in ops/scale details
  - 1 = superficial or incorrect architecture choices
- Problem solving & debugging (real incident examples) — weight 25%
  - 5 = clear root-cause framework, on-call incident responsibility and mitigations
- Collaboration & cross-team communication (stakeholder mgmt) — weight 15%
  - 5 = demonstrates partnership examples, conflict resolution, written comms samples
- Autonomy & prioritization (ship and measure) — weight 15%
  - 5 = shipped features with measurable impact and monitoring strategy
- Culture & growth fit (feedback orientation, craft) — weight 10%
  - 5 = clear growth arcs, mentorship, inclusive practices

Scoring matrix example (to paste into scorecard):
- Raw score = sum(weighted category scores). Normalize to 100.
- Fail thresholds: any category = 1 => auto-red (disqualify unless strong mitigation).
- Hire thresholds: normalized >= 75 => green. 60–74 => discuss (needs strong manager conviction). <60 => no-go.

Decision protocol (rapid):
- Panel Captain consolidates scores and lists top 3 evidence bullets per candidate.
- Hiring manager advocates for role fit; recruiter confirms comp band and target start window.
- If split opinion, use two-step tie-breaker: 1) potential for rapid impact (30/60-day plan), 2) team growth alignment (mentorship/skill gap).

DayZero warm-hand-off packet (what recruiter sends to onboarding owner / manager on offer acceptance):
- One-pager: Role brief + 30/60/90 outcomes (3 bullet outcomes per period).
- Candidate snapshot: 3 strengths, 2 development areas, 3 sample projects they’ll pick up first.
- Interview evidence file: consolidated scorecard + panel notes (one-line bullets).
- Access & tooling checklist: accounts to request (Slack, Google Drive, internal repo access, infra staging).
- Hardware & seat request: pro tip: mark for expedited procurement if sign date < 14 days.
- First-week meeting plan: 30/60/90 onboarding owner items + buddy pairing.

DayZero packet template (copyable):
- Role: [ROLE]
body_continued:
- Start target: [YYYY-MM-DD]
- Hiring manager: [Name] | Onboarding owner: [Name]
- Critical projects to join week 1: [proj-a], [proj-b]
- 30/60/90 outcomes: [outcome bullets]
- Slack intros: [channels]

90-day probing schedule (people-ops + manager check-ins):
- Day 7: quick sync (1:1) to ensure access and first tasks queued. (manager)
- Day 30: success signals review — did the hire complete first-impact milestone? (manager + people-ops)
- Day 60: calibration on ramp speed and blockers; adjust mentor pairing if needed. (manager)
- Day 90: probation review and promotion/hire evidence capture. (manager + people-ops)

Quick templates (copy/paste):
- Offer approval subject: "Offer Approval — [Candidate] — [Role] — Target comp"
- Panel Captain consolidation note (DM): "Consolidated: candidate A=81, B=68, C=54. A recommended. Key evidence: (1) delivered X at scale, (2) strong infra debugging, (3) clear mentor examples."

Notes to recruiter/hiring manager (practical):
- Keep interview loops to a maximum of 3 — each extra loop delays momentum and reduces accept rate.
- Ask panels to write 1-line evidence per rubric item; narrative helps during fast decisions.
- If the role spans infra + product, double-weight domain competence for first hire.

Open questions / flags (items to resolve before using this slate):
- Comp bands for cross-regional hires (EMEA/APAC) — who signs off outside US bands? (TODO: Priya to confirm process).
- Internal transfer probation length variance — can we standardize at 60 days for lateral moves? (Action: People Ops review).

Appendix: sample 30-day impact OR checklist for manager to own during onboarding:
- Week 1: access validated, intro meetings scheduled, first small ticket assigned (tracking issue).
- Week 2: initial code/infra walkthrough scheduled, buddy pairing begins.
- Week 3-4: first measurable change (bug fix, simple perf improvement, doc update).

If you use this doc, please add final candidate decisions to CONFLUENCE:HR/DayZero-Warmhand-2025 and tag #people-ops-hiring on Slack so we can capture lessons learned.
